title: Public transport and who can reach it
about: Who lives within reach of public transport, as SDG 11.2.1 asks, read under every declared reading of its open terms: whether a tram is of low or high capacity, which UN-Habitat's metadata leaves unnamed; whether a stop counts only where its mean wait at the morning peak is at most twenty minutes, the metadata's secondary indicator; along the streets, as the metadata asks, or in a straight line, as is often done. Each reading gives its own share, and none is the indicator's value until one is chosen. Every stop's service on a declared weekday is read from a GTFS Schedule feed: its departures an hour at the peak and the mean wait of a passenger arriving at random, exact and taken beyond the window where the day goes on. People are GHS-POP's, shared among buildings; ways are Overture's. The mathematics is urban science's, on its access network and morphe's shortest paths.
